description: Create an index.html that serves as a simple landing/redirect page for the repository, and ensure the PDF is generated as a final artifact.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Presupuesto/index.html - a simple, clean page that links to the HTML version and mentions the Typst source. It should have basic styling with the SmartTemp brand colors. Include a link to propuesta-smarttemp.html and a note that the professional PDF is generated from propuesta-smarttemp.typ using Typst.
Compile the final PDF: typst compile propuesta-smarttemp.typ propuesta-smarttemp.pdf
Verify both files exist and are properly linked
acceptance_criteria: index.html exists and is valid HTML
index.html mentions the Typst source file
propuesta-smarttemp.pdf compiles successfully from the .typ source
verification: cd /projects/sandbox/Presupuesto && typst compile propuesta-smarttemp.typ propuesta-smarttemp.pdf && echo 'PDF compiled'
findings: index.html created with SmartTemp branding (#29b6f6), links to propuesta-smarttemp.html, and mentions the Typst source. PDF compiled successfully at 118KB.
